item.title: 7 dead after small plane crashes in central Mexico while attempting emergency landing
item.description: A small plane crashed in an industrial area of central Mexico while attempting an emergency landing, killing at least seven people, Mexican authorities said.

item.title: North Bay first responders, residents gear up for parade of storms
item.description: The Sonoma County Fire District is reminding drivers to be safe on the roads. "Turn around, don't drown. We repeat it, unfortunately, we have to keep repeating it, we do have areas which flood," said Deputy Chief Matt Windrem.

item.title: At least 13 people injured in cable car incident in SF, fire officials say
item.description: Several people are injured after a cable car came to a sudden stop in San Francisco on Monday, according to San Francisco fire officials. SKY7 video shows shattered glass on the window.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Brother shares how siblings escaped Hayward gas line explosion
item.description: "They have burns all over their bodies and broken bones." For the first time, Jorge Duenas Ponce is speaking, giving a voice to his brother, sister and niece who were inside the Hayward home when it exploded.
